manual_review_note: Reviewed legacy-rule contexts as history, rejected proposals, or future scope; no obsolete business rule presented as current. README Bearer literals are documented demo values.
scope_note: Passed documentation checks only. Docker evidence is cited separately by its original accepted run ID.
limitations: Read-only scope is README.md, AI_USAGE.md and docs/*.md, excluding evidence and logs.
Markdown and GitHub heading anchor checks are local heuristics, not full renderer validation.
External HTTP links are inventoried but not fetched by this script.
Credential values are never included in output; pattern scanning is not a complete security proof.
Legacy-rule context classification requires human review and cannot prove semantic consistency.
This report does not establish Docker acceptance or source-code correctness.
The script is a local ignored audit helper and is not intended for the documentation commit.
